title: SafetyOverride
description: Human operator override event — approving or rejecting a high-risk action.

site_id.description: The facility where the action would be executed.

action_description.description: Human-readable description of the action being authorised or rejected.

operator_id.description: Unique identifier of the authorised operator who made this decision.

response_latency_s.description: Seconds from escalation to operator decision.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp of the override decision.
